name: Generate THOR Cloud launcher
description: Link an existing or create a new THOR Cloud campaign, then generate a launcher URL and an OS-specific download-and-run command. The returned URL and command contain a sensitive campaign token and must not be logged or shared.

campaign_id.title: Campaign ID
campaign_id.description: UUID of an active THOR Cloud campaign to use. Fill in either Campaign ID or Campaign name.

campaign_name.title: Campaign name
campaign_name.description: Name of a new campaign to create. Fill in either Campaign ID or Campaign name.

launcher_type.title: Target operating system
launcher_type.description: Launcher matching the target asset operating system

product.title: THOR Cloud product
product.description: THOR Cloud or THOR Cloud Lite, matching the API key of the account

campaign_description.title: Campaign description
campaign_description.description: Optional description of the new campaign. Only used when creating a new campaign.

assigned_contract.title: Contract ID
assigned_contract.description: Optional contract identifier used to license scans. Only used when creating a new campaign.

end_date.title: Expiration date
end_date.description: Optional campaign expiration in RFC 3339 format, including timezone. Only used when creating a new campaign.

scan_profile.title: Scan profile name
scan_profile.description: Optional predefined profile name exactly as shown in THOR Cloud; it is resolved through the account scan profiles API. Only used when creating a new campaign.

scan_limit.title: Scan limit
scan_limit.description: Optional maximum number of scans; zero means unlimited. Only used when creating a new campaign.

scan_threads.title: Scanner threads
scan_threads.description: Optional number of scanner threads. Only used when creating a new campaign.

campaign_id.description: UUID of the THOR Cloud campaign

campaign_name.description: Name of the linked or newly created campaign

campaign_created.description: Whether this action created the campaign

launcher_url.description: Sensitive tokenized URL from which the target can download the launcher

command.description: Sensitive OS-specific command that downloads and runs the launcher
